reasons: Only twelve of sixteen sections were available in the packet, so the last four helpers are unreviewed here.
Text accuracy in Hindi is not checked by any shown test beyond a few phrases.

terms.meaning: the language setting the app is using, here English or Hindi
a name used to look up one piece of text in the dictionary

sections.name: Locale
sections.title: Language choice type
sections.what: Defines the two allowed language values, English and Hindi.
sections.why: Likely reason: stops other language values from being used by mistake. Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: Translation
sections.title: Translation shape
sections.what: Describes the structure every language copy must follow, with named groups for navigation, buttons, pages and labels.
sections.why: Likely reason: forces both languages to have the same keys. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Adding a key here means both the English and Hindi copies must be updated.

sections.name: en
sections.title: English copy
sections.what: Holds the English words and sentences for navigation, buttons, labels and page text.
sections.why: Likely reason: the default language for the app. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Several sentences state that the app is a prototype and not legal advice, so edits must keep that message.

sections.name: hi, copy, t
sections.title: Hindi copy and lookup helpers
sections.what: Holds the Hindi copy with the same structure as English, and exposes the copy and a function that picks a language.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets every page look up text by language. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The lookup falls back to nothing for an unknown language, so only the two valid locale values should be passed.

sections.name: redesignI18n (part 1)
sections.title: Redesign text, first part
sections.what: Holds the English text for the redesigned home and case pages, covering the hero, the feature lists, and the difference cards.
sections.why: Likely reason: the redesigned screens use their own text set. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Some numbers such as the 5 percent limit and the 1.20 and 1.02 acre values are typed in as text, so they will not update if the data changes.

sections.name: redesignI18n (part 2)
sections.title: Redesign text, English tail and Hindi start
sections.what: Finishes the English redesign text covering the evidence, the map and the footer, then starts the Hindi redesign text.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps both redesign language sets together. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Hindi redesign keys must match the English keys exactly.

sections.name: redesignI18n (part 3)
sections.title: Redesign text, Hindi tail
sections.what: Finishes the Hindi redesign text covering the difference cards, the evidence area and the map labels.
sections.why: Likely reason: completes the matching Hindi set. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Hindi wording here mixes English terms with Hindi, so it should be reviewed by a Hindi speaker.

sections.name: localizedPeopleCount
sections.title: People count phrase
sections.what: Returns the people count phrase in the chosen language, with singular wording for one person.
sections.why: Likely reason: the count phrase needs the right form for one versus many. Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: localizedExperiencePresentation, localizedOfficialRecordPresentation
sections.title: Experience page text
sections.what: Returns the text blocks for the experience pages in the chosen language, including the landing page, documents and traceability labels.
sections.why: Likely reason: the experience pages need their own text set. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The documents text notes that fixtures are separate from core records, so changing it may confuse users.

sections.name: localizedOfficialRecordInspectionPresentation
sections.title: Official record inspection text
sections.what: Returns the labels and messages for viewing an official-style record, including the validation and error messages.
sections.why: Likely reason: the inspection screen needs its own labels and warnings. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The warnings say records are not authoritative, which must stay visible to users.

sections.name: localizedOfficialRecordDocumentsPresentation
sections.title: Imported records text
sections.what: Returns the labels for the imported records section, including loading and error messages.
sections.why: Likely reason: the imported records section needs its own labels. Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: localizedEarthObservationPresentation
sections.title: Earth observation text
sections.what: Returns the labels, summaries and safety notes for the satellite comparison screen in the chosen language.
sections.why: Likely reason: the satellite screen needs its own text, including the statement that its results are not legal evidence. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The safety notes say the images do not establish ownership or boundaries, which must be kept.

sections.name: localizedParcelComparisonPresentation
sections.title: Area comparison wording in both languages
sections.what: Returns the labels, explanations and status messages for the parcel area comparison screen, in English or Hindi. It picks the summary message that matches the summary key it is given, and uses the "needs more information" message when no key is given.
sections.why: Keeps all area comparison wording in one place so each language reads the same way across the screen.
sections.watch_out: The summary lookup ends with a non-null assertion, so an unknown summary key returns nothing and the screen may fail without a clear error.

sections.name: localizedVerificationPresentation
sections.title: Verification result wording
sections.what: Returns the title and explanation for one check result. It handles the area check and the family check, and it says plainly when there is not enough information to compare, stating that this is not a discrepancy.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond keeping result wording consistent for each outcome.
sections.watch_out: Only the area check gets its own wording. Any other rule identifier falls through to the family wording, so a new check would show the wrong text.

sections.name: localizedPacketPresentation
sections.title: Review packet summary and request text
sections.what: For the area check or the family check, returns a short summary and a request sentence that asks a reviewer to look at the listed records. Both languages are supported.
sections.why: Likely reason: the packet is a draft that a person reviews, so the request text is prepared in advance.
sections.watch_out: The text describes the records as synthetic. If real records ever reach this wording, the message would be wrong.

sections.name: localizedTimelinePresentation
sections.title: Timeline event labels
sections.what: Gives a title and explanation for each timeline entry. Known entries get fixed text, entries whose id ends in created or ready get generic packet text, and any other entry uses the fallback text passed in.
sections.why: Timeline ids come from elsewhere in the app, so unknown ids fall back to text supplied by the caller.
sections.watch_out: Matching is done by the end of the id, so a new id that ends in ready will show the "ready for review" message even if it means something else.

summary: Holds all the English and Hindi text the app shows, plus helper functions that pick the right text for each page.
purpose: Lets every page show words in the chosen language from one place.
why: Likely reason: keeping all text in one file makes translations easier to check and change. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Defines the shape of a translation, then fills in English and Hindi copies with the same keys. It exposes the full copy and a lookup for each language. Helper functions return the text blocks for each page, choosing Hindi when the locale is Hindi and English otherwise.
inputs: A locale value of English or Hindi, and for count helpers a number.
outputs: Text blocks and phrases for the page that asked for them.
risks: Adding a key to one language but not the other is caught by the shape, but a missing or mistranslated phrase is not. Some Hindi strings mix English words.
debug: If text shows in the wrong language, check the locale passed to the helper. If text is missing, check the key name in both the English and Hindi copies.
